A NOTE FROM YOUR FIELD GUIDE

Make room for discovery.

Year tabs browse the curriculum; they don’t change your academic year. Set your actual year in the Field journal.

Inspect any course, follow its prerequisite links, and explore every region. Shared courses form everyone’s foundation. From Year 3, confirm your self-reported specialization before activating its courses.

Solid lines connect prerequisites in this view. Course details distinguish hard prerequisites, soft prerequisites, and co-requisites.

Academic completion is self-reported. Mastery quizzes and course descriptions are reserved for a later phase. The CIVINCO assessment and Hardmode review screens have their architecture in place, with assessments still to come.
